name: Electrocute
description: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3s strikes them with lightning for adaptive damage.

name: Aery
description: Attacks and abilities send Aery to damage enemies or shield allies. She returns to you after each trip.

name: Phase Rush
description: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3s grants a burst of movement speed and basic ability haste.

name: Conqueror
description: Hitting champions with attacks or abilities grants stacks of adaptive force. At max stacks gain bonus omnivamp.

name: Fleet Footwork
description: Moving and attacking builds energy; your next attack heals you and grants movement speed.

name: Empowerment
description: Attacking a champion 3 times empowers you, amplifying damage dealt to them for a short time.

name: Grasp of the Undying
description: While in combat, your next attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage, heals you and permanently increases your health.

name: Aftershock
description: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants bonus resistances, then releases a shockwave around you.

name: Lethal Tempo
description: Attacking an enemy champion grants stacking attack speed; at max stacks gain bonus attack range.

name: First Strike
description: Striking an enemy champion before they strike you grants bonus damage as gold and true damage for a short time.

name: Glacial Augment
description: Immobilizing an enemy creates frost rays that slow enemies and reduce their damage.

name: Arcane Comet
description: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location. Hitting champions empowers future comets.

name: Scorch
description: Your next damaging ability on a champion deals bonus burn damage.

name: Shield Bash
description: Gaining a shield empowers your next attack against a champion.

name: Sudden Impact
description: After leaving stealth or using a dash, blink or leap, gain bonus penetration on your next attacks and abilities.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Damaging a crowd-controlled enemy champion deals bonus true damage.

name: Mark of the Weak
description: Damaging an enemy champion with abilities marks them, increasing damage they take from you.

name: Eyeball Collector
description: Collecting eyeballs on takedowns permanently grants adaptive force.

name: Ingenious Hunter
description: Takedowns grant item haste, reducing item cooldowns.

name: Zombie Ward
description: Clearing enemy wards turns them into friendly zombie wards and grants adaptive force.

name: Brutal
description: Gain adaptive force and bonus penetration.

name: Triumph
description: Takedowns restore a portion of your missing health and deal bonus damage to low-health enemies.

name: Gathering Storm
description: Gain increasing adaptive force every few minutes.

name: Last Stand
description: Deal increased damage while low on health.

name: Giant Slayer
description: Deal bonus damage to champions with more max health than you.

name: Coup de Grace
description: Deal increased damage to low-health enemy champions.

name: Legend: Alacrity
description: Takedowns grant permanent attack speed.

name: Legend: Tenacity
description: Takedowns grant permanent tenacity (reduced crowd control duration).

name: Legend: Bloodline
description: Takedowns grant permanent omnivamp.

name: Font of Life
description: Damaging a slowed or immobilized champion marks them; allies attacking marked champions heal.

name: Courage of the Colossus
description: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants a shield that grows with nearby enemies.

name: Nullifying Orb
description: When low on health against magic damage, gain a magic damage shield.

name: Second Wind
description: After taking damage from a champion, regenerate health over time based on your missing health.

name: Loyalty
description: You and your nearest ally gain bonus armor and magic resist.

name: Bone Plating
description: After taking damage from a champion, the next 3 attacks or abilities against you deal reduced damage.

name: Overgrowth
description: Nearby dying minions and monsters permanently increase your max health.

name: Revitalize
description: Heals and shields you grant are stronger, especially on low-health targets.

name: Perseverance
description: Gaining a shield or heal empowers your next attack against a champion.

name: Onslaught
description: Takedowns grant a burst of movement speed and slow resistance.

name: Sweet Tooth
description: Honeyfruit heals for more and grants bonus gold when you eat it.

name: Hextech Flashtraption
description: While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash, a channelled blink.

name: Item Crafting
description: Removes the combine cost from your first completed item.

name: Transcendence
description: Gain ability haste; takedown events reduce your basic ability cooldowns.

name: Future's Market
description: You can enter debt to buy items, up to a limit.

name: Pathfinder
description: Gain movement speed in the river and near objectives.

name: Nimbus Cloak
description: Casting a summoner spell grants a burst of movement speed.

name: Demolish
description: Charges up while near an enemy structure; your next attack deals heavy bonus damage to it.

name: Manaflow Band
description: Hitting champions with abilities permanently increases your max mana.
